error[ZC-E0813]: a TLS handshake was refused
  cause  the server sent the fatal alert handshake_failure (40)
  fix    Check that the server at broker.botpike.com is the one this connection is configured for, and that it offers TLS 1.3 with an Ed25519 certificate from the pinned CA.
  more   zcube explain E0813 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0813.html
